common_constraints.body_construction: Allocate the actual explanation and useful visit information substantial readable space from the outset. Body line groups below are meaningful current design choices, flexible where the complete result works; they do not authorize rewriting copy or fitting a good result to coordinates. Mature Korean/Latin/numeral forms, meaningful word spaces, precise flat typesetting and clear contrast remain coherent within each group.

Give range dashes optically distinct extended midline forms, preserving numeric baselines and word boundaries. Font descriptions specify visual anatomy, not certification that native generation applied a font file.

Current instructions do not release this exclusion. Gothic, quiet space, pictorial scenes and a suitable individual direction's column remain available when the whole image-and-copy relationship fulfills this request.
common_constraints.style: Five current-content choices, not a permanent five-family runtime menu. Avoid clay/toy/complementary packages and repeating a large object, large heading and tiny footer. Plants carry substantive meaning and spatial organization, not merely garnish information.
common_constraints.workflow: Reuse learned ideas; no mandatory fresh source reading, source matching or layout guide. Makers receive their own direction and exact copy. No native call is initiated by this design-only artifact. R18 full closure remains the prerequisite for the parent beginning any new generation.

directions.working_name_not_printed: Photographic encounter: small pot and enveloping canopy
directions.whole_relationship: Unequal diagonal photographic encounters connect a modest two-line title at the lower-left seam to a broad middle paragraph, then turn into the market visit column at the right-hand crop edge.
directions.positive_direction:
Build a photographic editorial poster about choosing a plant whose scale belongs in a home. Edit an intimate row of small nursery pots at the lower left against an enveloping mature-leaf crop crossing the upper right. Between them, a closer view shows the natural attachment of a leaf to its stem and the rim of its actual pot. These are deliberate unequal crops; believable light, botanical attachment and pottery surfaces connect the photographs without implying different species are the same plant. The large leaf edge and descending pot row create a diagonal encounter. Its breathing seam is designed together with the real paragraph.

Set ‘집 안의 / 작은 숲’ beside the lower-left pot row as the primary verbal anchor in a moderately large mature Korean serif with open counters and controlled stroke contrast. Give ‘LEAVES & LIVING’ a compact companion role on that same axis, substantially smaller and lighter. The canopy edge points upward into the nearby slogan and three-line explanation at the middle seam. Set that paragraph in a clear medium-weight Korean sans with balanced rectangular syllables, generous inner spaces, compact proportional Latin and aligned lining numerals. At the assumed SNS view, treat it as full reading copy, around a comfortable 16-pixel body rather than a caption; reserve a roughly half-width continuous area and normal leading.

From its last line, the photographic crop meets the adjacent market-name/date/hours/venue column on the same horizontal ledge. Below that column, access and care remain adjacent, followed by the invitation and URL. Date weight is subordinate to the title but distinct from body weight. The invitation is a final conversational sentence. Use cool natural greens, charcoal, subdued porcelain and clean pale photographic highlights. Preserve photographic specificity and crisp planar type. The whole is an asymmetric encounter whose active image boundaries organize the reading turn.

directions.working_name_not_printed: A lively illustrated market table, read across
directions.whole_relationship: A continuous illustrated market table runs horizontally through the page, with the slogan leading into a four-line explanation over its left opening and a single visit-to-action column anchored to its right end.
directions.positive_direction:
Make a confident, convivial illustrated market panorama. A continuous oblique tabletop threads across the page, holding distinctly sized houseplants with recognizable pots, broad leaves and slender stems. At its left end, one visitor considers two different plants; at its right end, one grower attends to a newly potted plant. Draw people economically with purposeful posture and simple readable contact. A gap between pots and a short open tabletop edge admit the explanation; these openings follow the actual table and foliage silhouette. Plants and people form the main horizontal event, extending into outer crops.

Let ‘초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.’ enter first at the upper-left opening in lively but precise mid-weight Korean lettering, on two sensible phrase lines if needed. Make its weight and contrast plainly stronger than the adjoining explanation. The Korean title identifies the event on the neighboring table-edge axis, smaller than the slogan; its Latin companion belongs immediately beside or beneath it in compact upright capitals. The four-line paragraph begins directly below the slogan, left aligned with its first word. Use mature Korean humanist sans anatomy with open inner counters, consistent rounded stroke terminals rather than cartoon letters, a generous syllable body and restrained proportional Latin. Give the paragraph readable editorial prose weight; keep its final two lines joined as one request to choose a suitable plant.

The table's horizontal edge carries the eye from the paragraph's last line to the adjoining right-hand market name. Date, hours and venue form one stable visit stack there; access and care continue underneath, and the invitation hands off to the URL. Keep small type flat and clean while drawings retain ink-like contours, dense colored planes and selective imperfect edges. Use warm coral, tomato-red accents, ochre and deep leafy blue-green in a coherent drawn scene, with charcoal type. This is a broad social encounter with a lateral reading rhythm.

directions.whole_relationship: A substantial irregular plant colony turns around a date-and-market entry, leaving a left interior prose opening and a connected right access/care opening; the Korean/Latin title acts as a quieter lower-left identity.
directions.positive_direction:
Create a vivid cut-paper graphic plant colony whose shapes organize the whole poster. Broad leaf fans, narrow upright blades and small rounded-leaf stems grow from clearly attached pots around an irregular open passage. Plant groups enter from left, top and lower right at different scales; connected stems and planted bases remain readable. Curved and angular silhouettes create an asymmetric surrounding rhythm. Use substantial interlocking shapes across the image, with clean sharp cuts, intentional overlap and controlled flat color. Interior openings follow the colony and are sized together with actual prose and access information.

Put the date at the upper passage entrance as the strongest verbal anchor, in stable moderately heavy lining numerals. The adjoining smaller market name establishes the event; hours and venue continue nearby as one compact visit cluster. The slogan starts the left interior prose area; quiet emphasis leads into a five-line paragraph. Choose precise Korean sans anatomy with a generous medium-weight body, squared but open counters, consistent stem width, proportional Latin and even baselines. Leave natural word spaces and normal tight editorial leading. The paragraph needs a genuinely readable interior area rather than lettering fitted into narrow leaf slivers.

Its last line faces the adjoining right-hand opening across one short shared stem-led boundary. Begin there with the access line, then the care offer, invitation and URL in one coherent action group. The Korean title sits at the lower-left mouth of the passage as a compact identity on two meaningful word lines, with its Latin companion immediately beside it. Its weight is plainly less forceful than the date entrance. Use energetic leaf-green, deep navy, pale citron and controlled warm pink within the active cut shapes; type rests on clean contrasting spaces. The eye path enters a plant community, turns through explanation and exits through useful visit action. Substantial plants and their specific attachments make the passage meaningful.

directions.whole_relationship: Independent botanical specimens at stepped heights surround one open left-of-center reading column: the market identifier and date introduce the visit, its full explanation follows below, then access/care and invitation/URL continue directly. Plant canopies and pots actively cross the surrounding page rather than sit in a separate illustration panel.
directions.positive_direction:
Design a botanical editorial poster that takes the small-pot-to-grown-tree range seriously. Draw a small leafy pot, a middle-height branching houseplant and a taller indoor tree as independent specimens at gently descending ground heights. Show leaf attachment, branching, pot rims and visible soil with precise colored-pencil and ink articulation. The tall canopy crosses the upper crop and reaches inward; the smallest pot enters the lower-left foreground. A closer pot section at the right makes planted structure tangible. These independent specimens occupy substantial connected space around one open reading column, with actual plant edges determining where it opens.

Let the market name be the primary verbal identifier at the upper entrance of that left-of-center column. Its date receives controlled numeral emphasis, followed closely by hours and venue. Place the Korean title and Latin companion as a compact secondary identity adjoining this entry cluster, with the slogan as its quiet descriptive sentence. Their size and weight stay subordinate to the market identifier rather than compete elsewhere. The three-line explanatory paragraph follows the visit group directly down the same optical axis. Use a book-like Korean serif with sturdy thin strokes, short controlled triangular terminals, generous inner counters and a full readable body. Match proportional Latin and lining numerals to its optical size; dates and URL retain sufficient weight and clear baselines. Printed prose remains precise and flat, independent of pencil marks.

The final paragraph line hands off directly below to the access line and care offer as one close pair, then invitation and URL complete the column. Generous line width and ordinary leading keep this a readable uninterrupted route while varied botanical canopies and pot heights organize the surrounding page. Use mineral green, olive, warm bark brown and selective muted blue on clean light paper. Fine botanical observation makes the range of living scales inviting. The typography is a coherent local route inside the atlas composition, not independent captions attached to every specimen.

directions.working_name_not_printed: Painted moments of bringing living plants into daily life
directions.whole_relationship: Three unequal painted views form a rectilinear sequence around a central explanatory caption hinge; invitation enters there, paragraph descends into a lower central visit group, and a quieter title identifies the tall left view.
directions.positive_direction:
Construct a painterly editorial sequence about the intimate pleasure of living with plants. Use three unequal bounded views: a tall close view of overlapping houseplant leaves beside a lit window, a wider shallow view of varied pots at a market table, and a tight square of a well-rooted plant being settled in its pot. Render expressive gouache and oil-like masses with controlled brush edges, convincing botanical attachments and actual pot structure. Intervals and shared edges create a rectilinear rhythm. Fill interiors with substantive leaves, light across plants and pottery. The views evoke related experiences without labeling an invented chronological tutorial.

Let the actual invitation enter first at the central hinge under the market view, in a warm medium-weight Korean serif. Give it a noticeably stronger body and contrast than the explanation, with ‘편하게 들러 / 천천히 둘러보세요.’ as sensible phrase lines where useful. The explanatory paragraph starts immediately below on the same stable left edge: four full reading lines in a mature Korean sans with generous inner spaces, clean square syllable rhythm, moderate consistent stems and a calm Latin system. Preserve normal word spacing and clear lining numerals. Reserve a broad uninterrupted caption area sized for reading.

The last paragraph line meets the lower central market-name start through one short vertical continuation; date, hours and venue follow together. Access and the care offer remain paired below, with URL immediately after them. The Korean title identifies the tall left view at its lower edge in two modest word lines, its Latin companion sits beside it, and the slogan joins the identity as a supportive sentence. This lower identity stays quieter than the central invitation. Use deep indigo, plum, luminous leaf greens and selective honey-colored window light; keep typography precisely planar. The dark painted sequence and caption hinge form a complete image-and-copy system, with the invitation directing reading rather than a competing display title.
